title: PAve
venue_description:
Downtown Sioux Falls Nightlife Destination

PAve stands as one of Downtown Sioux Falls' premier nightlife destinations bringing a new standard of dining and entertainment to the city. The venue features multiple levels each offering a distinct atmosphere and experience for guests. The first floor known as Factory Avenue presents a contemporary industrial steampunk aesthetic that invites relaxation and conversation while the second floor Roxbury Avenue comes alive with live entertainment and features an outdoor patio perfect for socializing.

Music and Entertainment

Music is central to the PAve experience. The venue hosts weekly open mic nights every Tuesday starting at 9 PM welcoming musicians performers and artists of all genres and skill levels. These events have become a staple of the local music scene providing a platform for both emerging and established talent. Throughout the week PAve features live music performances DJ sets and special events that keep the energy high and the crowds engaged.

Food and Beverage Program

PAve operates a full kitchen serving unique food offerings that complement its extensive beverage program. The venue prides itself on its creative craft cocktail list alongside a carefully curated selection of beer and wine. Daily specials run throughout the week with Half-Priced Thursdays being particularly popular among regulars offering half-priced drinks all day long. Happy hour specials and late-night offerings ensure there's always value for guests.

Venue Spaces

Three different bars are strategically placed across the multiple levels each catering to different crowds and moods. The industrial first floor provides the perfect setting for business meetings and casual happy hours while the second floor with its LED-lit bar top and entertainment focus attracts those seeking a more vibrant nightlife experience. The outdoor patio extends the venue's footprint offering fresh air and views of downtown.

Hours and Accessibility

PAve maintains extensive hours to serve the downtown community. Open Monday through Wednesday from 11 AM to midnight Thursday and Friday from 11 AM to 2 AM and Saturday from noon to 2 AM the venue is closed on Sundays. This schedule accommodates both lunch crowds and late-night revelers. The venue is 21+ only ensuring an adult atmosphere. Located at 130 South Phillips Avenue PAve sits in the heart of downtown making it easily accessible for both locals and visitors exploring the city.
location: 130 S Phillips Ave Sioux Falls SD 57104

title: Wiley's Tavern
venue_description:
Historic Downtown Gathering Place

Wiley's Tavern has established itself as a beloved historic spot in downtown Sioux Falls serving as the community's go-to destination for quality food drinks and entertainment. Located at 330 North Main Avenue the venue combines the charm of a classic tavern with modern entertainment offerings creating a welcoming atmosphere that appeals to diverse crowds. The establishment has built its reputation on consistency friendliness and a genuine commitment to providing great times for all who walk through its doors.

Live Music and Open Mic Programming

Music programming is a cornerstone of the Wiley's experience. Every Tuesday night from 8 PM the venue hosts open mic nights welcoming singers musicians comedians and poets to share their talents. The comprehensive technical setup includes quarter-inch cables for guitars and keyboards DI boxes Bluetooth connectivity to the mixer both wired Shure SM58 microphones and wireless options music stands keyboard stands and stools. This professional-grade support makes Wiley's a favorite among local performers. Thursday nights feature live music from local and regional bands spanning genres including rock country blues and acoustic performances running from 7 PM to 11 PM. Additionally karaoke takes center stage on Tuesday nights starting at 9 PM offering yet another outlet for musical expression.

Special Events and Entertainment

Beyond weekly music programming Wiley's hosts a rotating calendar of special events. First Friday celebrations occur monthly featuring themed nights with matching music decor and specialty drinks - themes have included Y2K Glow Up and Wild West among others. These events start the weekend off right and have become downtown traditions. The venue also organizes lively block parties that spill onto the streets and golf tournaments that challenge players while building community. Trivia nights provide intellectual entertainment for those seeking a different kind of competition.

Sports Viewing Experience

Sports fans find Wiley's to be an ideal viewing destination. The venue features more than 30 HD televisions including the largest big screen in downtown Sioux Falls ensuring there isn't a bad seat in the house. With the full NFL Sunday Ticket package every game is accessible whether it's a hometown team or a rival matchup. The combination of great sightlines quality screens and the energetic atmosphere makes game day at Wiley's a popular choice.

Food and Drink

Classic bar food forms the foundation of Wiley's menu. The kitchen serves burgers sandwiches and appetizers with the loaded nachos earning particular praise from regular customers. Daily drink specials keep the offerings fresh and affordable with happy hour deals and late-night specials ensuring value throughout operating hours. The full bar provides a wide selection to satisfy any preference.

Hours and Location

Wiley's maintains a schedule that serves both day and night crowds. Monday through Friday the venue opens at 3 PM and runs until 2 AM while Saturday and Sunday hours extend from 11 AM to 2 AM accommodating brunch crowds and early gatherings. The downtown location on Main Avenue places Wiley's in the heart of the action making it easily accessible and a natural stop for those exploring the city.
location: 330 N Main Ave Sioux Falls SD 57104

title: Corner Pub and Casino
venue_description:
Eastside Neighborhood Venue

Corner Pub and Casino serves as a welcoming neighborhood establishment on Sioux Falls' east side at 2408 East 6th Street. The venue has built its reputation on creating a friendly atmosphere where community members can gather for drinks entertainment and good times. Known for its approachable staff and genuine community spirit the pub maintains a relaxed casual environment that feels like a home away from home for regulars while remaining welcoming to newcomers.

Music and Entertainment

Live music and open mic opportunities are central to the Corner Pub's weekly programming. Wednesday evenings from 6 PM to 9 PM feature open mic sessions welcoming local musicians and performers to share their talents in a supportive neighborhood setting. The venue provides basic PA system support for performers. Weekend programming includes live music events that bring energy and excitement to the eastside location. Saturday nights offer additional entertainment options with darts and karaoke providing variety for guests seeking different types of fun.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The pub maintains a casual inviting atmosphere characterized by its bright and functional lighting - while some have noted the cafeteria-style brightness the focus remains on creating a comfortable space for socializing and entertainment. Plenty of seating options accommodate groups of various sizes and multiple television screens ensure sports fans can catch their favorite games. The venue operates on a cash-only basis so guests should plan accordingly when visiting.

Food and Beverage

While primarily focused on beverages the Corner Pub occasionally offers pizza and other light food options to complement the drinking experience. The emphasis remains on reasonably priced drinks that keep the neighborhood atmosphere accessible and welcoming. The combination of affordable pricing and friendly service has helped build a loyal local following over the years.

title: DaDa Gastropub
venue_description:
Creative Dining and Music Venue

DaDa Gastropub represents a unique fusion of culinary creativity musical entertainment and artistic expression in downtown Sioux Falls. Located at 402 North Main Avenue within the ICON Events building the venue occupies a historic space that once served as a John Deere factory. This industrial heritage is celebrated through eclectic artwork and decor inspired by the Dadaist art movement of the early 20th century. The gastropub embodies the spirit of Dadaism bringing new and exciting food and drink experiences to the Sioux Falls community while serving as a cultural gathering place.

Music Programming

Live music forms an integral part of the DaDa experience with multiple weekly offerings that have established the venue as a hub for the downtown music scene. Tuesday nights feature The Heinous 3 the house band performing from 8 PM to 10 PM in a free show that draws regular crowds. Sunday evenings bring the Sunday Night Blues Revue and Jam featuring house band The Double-O-Forty-Four with members Matt Billion Connor Pederson Chris Pohlson and Craig Atkins. This blues jam starting at 5 PM welcomes musicians to sit in and participate creating an interactive musical experience. The venue regularly welcomes touring acts and occasionally closes the dining room early to accommodate special performances demonstrating its commitment to bringing diverse musical experiences to Sioux Falls.

Culinary Experience

The gastropub specializes in unique cuisine options that prioritize sustainable and local product sourcing. The ever-changing menu reflects seasonal availability and the chef's creative vision ensuring return visitors always find something new to explore. Sunday nights feature shrimp and grits among other specialties while the regular menu offers thoughtful cuisine that pairs beautifully with the beverage program. Full dinner service runs until 10 PM supporting both the dining and music experiences.

Beverage Program

DaDa's full bar focuses on expertly-crafted cocktails that showcase creativity and quality. The cocktail menu features innovative combinations and seasonal offerings that change to keep the experience fresh. Wine and beer selections complement the cocktail program providing options for all preferences. The bar remains open until 11 PM Tuesday through Saturday extending the experience beyond dinner service.

Atmosphere and Design

The venue's industrial heritage is transformed into an intimate welcoming space through thoughtful design. A beautiful covered patio features functional original garage doors that open into the dining room creating a unique indoor-outdoor atmosphere that blurs the boundaries between spaces. This design element is particularly appreciated during pleasant weather allowing natural air flow and connection to the downtown environment. Throughout the interior Dada-style artwork and decor create visual interest and conversation pieces reflecting the anti-conventional spirit of the Dadaist movement.

Location and Partnership

Located directly across from the Old Courthouse Museum on Main Avenue DaDa sits in the heart of historic downtown near Falls Park and the Levitt Bandshell. This proximity to other cultural attractions makes it a natural stop for those exploring the city. As a sister business to Parker's Bistro another beloved Sioux Falls establishment DaDa benefits from proven restaurant expertise while maintaining its own distinct identity.

Hours and Access

DaDa Gastropub operates Tuesday through Saturday with doors opening at 5 PM. This evening-focused schedule positions the venue as a dinner and nightlife destination rather than a lunch spot. The venue is closed Monday and Sunday except for special events ensuring the team can maintain quality and focus during operating hours.
location: 402 N Main Ave Sioux Falls SD 57104

title: Full Circle Book Co-op
venue_description:
Independent Bookstore and Cultural Hub

Full Circle Book Co-op stands as a vibrant cultural hub in downtown Sioux Falls merging the pleasures of reading with community gathering space and artistic expression. Located at 123 West 10th Street this inclusive independent bookstore beer and wine bar and event space has created something truly special - a safe welcoming environment where people of all ages backgrounds and identities can hang out discuss create and enjoy. The venue embodies progressive values and celebrates diversity making it a beloved destination for those seeking both literary enrichment and genuine community connection.

Books and Literary Collections

The co-op boasts an impressive collection of both new and used books carefully curated to appeal to diverse literary tastes. Rare finds and signed editions appear regularly among the shelves rewarding dedicated browsers with unexpected treasures. Local and regional authors receive prominent featuring with extensive selections showcasing the creative talent of the community. The affordable pricing particularly on used books makes building a personal library accessible to all. Beyond the shelves the co-op actively supports literacy through book donations to local shelters and prisons and is developing a pen-pal program with incarcerated individuals at the local penitentiary demonstrating commitment to expanding access to literature.

Events and Performance Programming

Sunday evenings from 7 PM to 10 PM bring open mic nights that welcome musicians poets comedians and performers of all types. While poetry holds a special place in the venue's heart all artistic expressions find support here. These events foster community engagement and provide platforms for both emerging and established artists. Non-profit poetry open mics specifically raise funds for local organizations turning artistic expression into community support. Beyond open mics the venue hosts live podcasts poetry readings book clubs author events and various community gatherings throughout the week. The programming creates multiple entry points for participation ensuring there's always a reason to visit and connect.

Bar and Cafe Service

The unique combination of bookstore and bar creates an inviting atmosphere where guests can enjoy beverages while browsing reading or attending events. Beer and wine selections emphasize local craft offerings supporting regional breweries and wineries. Coffee tea and non-alcoholic beverages ensure all guests find suitable refreshments regardless of preference. This hospitality element transforms the bookstore from a quick shopping stop into a destination where people linger connect and return regularly.

Community Mission and Values

Full Circle operates as an active ally in the LGBTQ+ community with explicit commitment to inclusivity and safety. The venue promotes progressive ideals through education creative writing poetry and the arts creating space for voices and perspectives that might not find platforms elsewhere. Local artists find support through vendor booths that showcase and sell their work. The co-op believes deeply in strengthening the creative and progressive community in Sioux Falls using the space as a gathering point for like-minded individuals while remaining genuinely welcoming to all who respect these values.

Atmosphere and Experience

Visitors consistently describe the atmosphere as magical warm and welcoming - a place that feels safe and separate from everyday concerns. The cozy environment features comfortable seating that encourages settling in with a book or engaging in conversation. The friendly staff contribute significantly to the positive experience offering recommendations answering questions and creating genuine connections with regular and new visitors alike. The delightful aroma that greets guests upon entry - a combination of books coffee and warm space - adds to the sensory appeal. Regular customers speak of the venue as their favorite place in town and many make it a required stop on every visit to Sioux Falls.

Hours and Accessibility

Operating hours accommodate both daytime browsers and evening event attendees. Monday through Thursday the co-op is open from 4 PM to 10 PM. Friday hours extend from 4 PM to midnight. Saturdays offer the longest window from 10 AM to midnight allowing full day visits. Sundays run from noon to 10 PM. These hours ensure the space serves both as a daytime literary destination and evening entertainment venue. WiFi availability and comfortable seating make the co-op suitable for remote work reading sessions or casual meetings. The downtown location at 10th and West makes it easily accessible for both residents and visitors exploring the city.
